description: Trim templates take tools, elytra and shields as well as armor at the smithing table, and the pattern shows on them

mods.name: Smithing Templates
mods.description: Trim templates take tools, elytra and shields as well as armor at the smithing table, and the pattern shows on them

releases.notes:
- Shields take every pattern: the face carries vanilla's own worn trim for it, the helmet's band over the chestplate's emblem, on the icon and in the hand, raised or not.
- A trimmed tool's icon shows one inlay in the colour of the material, the way a trimmed armor icon does, rather than a drawing per pattern.
- Worn elytra show vanilla's own worn trim for the pattern.
- The templates say they apply to tools, elytra and shields.
- Needs Pandorical 15.24.0 or newer, whose language merge keeps the templates' new wording beside other mods' text.
